quests.learnMore:
Before diving into discovery flows, understand the framework that ties everything together.

You'll learn:
• How Skills, Problems, and Persona combine to create opportunities
• What the competence wheels represent
• How proficiency levels light up your unique profile
• Which flows to start with based on your goals

This 2-minute explainer sets you up for success with all Flow Finder quests.

quests.name: Understand Play-List
quests.description: Learn how the Play-List Matrix turns your skills into courage challenges
quests.learnMore:
Discover what a play-list is, the 5 visibility layers from Screen to Authority, how the groan zone scoring works, and how AI generates courage challenges from your unique skills.

This 2-minute explainer sets you up for success with the Play-List Matrix.

quests.name: Mind Space Extraction
quests.description: Extract your skills, problems, and people from AI conversation history
quests.learnMore:
If you've had meaningful conversations with ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI about your work, interests, or goals, this tool extracts patterns you might not see yourself.

Instead of answering 45+ minutes of questions, paste your AI's analysis and review what it found. It's like having a mirror held up to your thinking.

This feeds directly into your Flow Finder data, giving you a head start on understanding your unique skills, the problems you care about, and the people you want to serve.

quests.name: Play-List Finder
quests.description: Discover your skills through play, role models, and what feels fun
quests.learnMore:
Your 'play-list' is the collection of activities that feel like play to you but look like work to others.

This flow helps you discover your authentic skills through:
• Role models who inspire you
• Activities you'd do with zero fear
• Secret wishes about what you'd get paid for
• Things that sound fun but make you nervous (your groan zone)

AI analyzes your answers and recommends skill segments you can confirm or reject. It's a faster, more intuitive way to discover what you're naturally great at.

quests.name: Persona Identifier
quests.description: Discover who you're meant to serve through your life chapters
quests.learnMore:
Your life journey reveals who you're meant to serve.

This flow helps you discover your ideal personas through:
• Your life chapters and major phases
• The struggles you've overcome
• People you've naturally helped

AI analyzes your journey and recommends personas you're positioned to serve. People often help those a few steps behind them on a similar path.

quests.placeholder: What was the situation? What were you doing?
quests.learnMore:
Tracking when your essence shows up helps you identify how aligned your work is with your essence.

You're training your awareness so you can show-up from this place more often.

The topics you're excited to learn about reveal what you're meant to share with the world.

Most people dismiss their interests as 'just hobbies,' but tracking them over time reveals patterns that point to your unique genius and potential business opportunities.

quests.name: Embody Your Essence
quests.description: What's a moment where you were on auto-pilot and consciously tapped into your essence voice to show up consciously?
quests.placeholder: What did you do?

quests.name: Dopamine Diet Change
quests.description: What's a moment where instead of defaulting to 'fast-food' joy, you pursued 'nutritious' joy instead?
quests.placeholder: What 'fast-food' joy do you usually default to and what was the 'nutritious' joy you chose instead?
quests.learnMore:
Fast-food joy is anything where you feel good in the moment, but leaves you feeling lower after. Think: drinking alcohol, eating high-sugar foods, scrolling social media, watching netflix.

Nutritious joy is anything where you suffer but it leaves you feeling better after. Think: purposeful work, going to the gym, vulnerable conversations with friends/family, learning something new.

The more you choose nutritious joy, the less you'll crave the fast-food hits. You're literally rewiring your brain's reward system.

quests.placeholder: What did you do that future successful you would have done?

quests.placeholder: How did you shift from protective to essence?

quests.name: Make It A Hell Yea
quests.description: What event this week flowed into your life that was an immediate "hell yea" or what event wasn't a hell yea but you turned into one by changing something about it?
quests.placeholder: What event this week was a Hell Yea for you?
quests.learnMore:
What's the difference between an A-grade actor and a C-grade actor who started with the same talent? One said yes to any opportunity and found themselves too busy to say yes to the "hell yea" ones when they did come and one said yes to only "Hell Yea" opportunities which led to more hell yeas.

By bringing awareness to what a "hell yea" is for you also shows what you're interested in and what you want to be doing.

Your answers will be saved to your profile and emailed to you as a keepsake.

quests.name: 3% Better
quests.description: In your business what can you make 3% better this week?
quests.placeholder: What did you improve by 3%?
quests.learnMore:
The 3% rule focuses on marginal gains as a recipe for success instead of massive transformation. These small consistent improvements compound exponentially.

Instead of 'I need to completely overhaul my website,' you ask 'What's 3% better?' Maybe it's improving one headline, simplifying your offer, or speeding up your response time. Tiny improvements sustained over time create massive growth.

quests.description: Identify and remove yourself from an environment, relationship, or situation that drains your essence.

quests.learnMore: When you put hot water and cold water in the same glass, the temperature meets in the middle. Human's are the same, this is why we become the average of our 5 closest friends and why the content we consume shapes our worldview. Sometimes the most impactful thing you can do is remove yourself from spaces, people, or situations that drain your energy or require you to be someone you're not. quests.name: Stage 1 Groan: Validation
quests.description: Reach out to someone and ask for honest feedback on your idea, even though you fear they might reject it or say it's not good enough.
quests.placeholder: Who did you reach out to? What feedback did they give? How did it feel?
quests.learnMore:
Fear of rejection when asking for feedback is one of the biggest blockers in the Validation stage.

Your essence knows you need real feedback to move forward, but your body fears hearing 'no' or 'this isn't good.'

This groan challenges you to face that fear directly. Remember: every piece of feedback—positive or negative—brings you closer to something that truly serves people.

quests.name: Understand Product Creation
quests.description: Learn what you'll build in this stage and why the Value Equation matters
quests.learnMore:
Before diving into product quests, understand what you're building and why.

You'll learn:
• The Value Equation: how to maximise what your product is worth
• The four things you'll build: Product, Lead Magnet, Offer, Package
• Why "done beats perfect" at this stage
• How to ship before you feel ready

This 2-minute explainer sets you up for success with all Product Creation quests.

quests.name: Stage 2 Groan: Creation
quests.description: Ship something (a page, a product, content) before you feel it's 100% ready. Your essence knows it's good enough, but your body fears judgment.
quests.placeholder: What did you ship? What was your fear? How did it actually go?
quests.learnMore:
Fear of imperfection / shipping before it's ready is the killer of progress in the Creation stage.

Perfectionism is procrastination in disguise. Your essence knows that 'done' beats 'perfect,' but your body fears judgment and criticism.

This groan challenges you to ship something before you feel ready. The truth? You'll never feel 100% ready. And the feedback you get from shipping is infinitely more valuable than another round of polishing.

quests.name: Stage 3 Groan: Testing
quests.description: Ask a tester to be brutally honest about what's NOT working. Sit with the discomfort of criticism without defending or explaining.
quests.placeholder: Who gave you feedback? What did they say wasn't working? How did you receive it?
quests.learnMore:
Fear of hearing negative feedback prevents growth in the Testing stage.

Your essence knows that honest criticism is a gift—it shows you exactly where to improve. But your body wants to defend, explain, or avoid the discomfort.

This groan challenges you to actively seek out criticism and sit with it. Don't defend. Don't explain. Just listen and thank them. The discomfort you feel is growth happening.

quests.name: Stage 4 Groan: Money
quests.description: Tell someone your price confidently without apologizing, discounting, or over-explaining. Own your value even when it feels uncomfortable.
quests.placeholder: What was the price conversation? How did you state your price? What happened?
quests.learnMore:
Fear of charging money / being 'salesy' blocks abundance in the Money Models stage.

Your essence knows your value. Your body fears being seen as greedy, pushy, or not worth the price.

This groan challenges you to own your value out loud. State your price without the softening language: no 'it's just,' no 'sorry it's a bit expensive,' no lengthy justifications. Let the price stand on its own. Your confidence in your value creates confidence in your customers.

quests.name: Stage 5 Groan: Offer
quests.description: Add one more bonus or strengthen your guarantee beyond what feels comfortable. Your essence knows abundance attracts abundance, but your body fears you're giving away too much value.
quests.placeholder: What bonus did you add or how did you strengthen your guarantee? What felt uncomfortable about it?
quests.learnMore:
Fear of making your offer too good or giving away too much is the edge you hit in the Offer Creation stage.

Your essence knows that a truly irresistible offer creates raving fans and referrals. But your body fears you're underselling yourself or giving away the farm.

This groan challenges you to over-deliver. Add that extra bonus. Make your guarantee stronger. Stack more value. The mindset shift: you're not giving away value—you're building a moat around your business through generosity.

quests.name: Stage 7 Groan: Launch
quests.description: Make a bold, public commitment to your launch with a specific date. Announce it to your audience. No backing out, no moving the goalposts.
quests.placeholder: What commitment did you make? Where did you announce it? How does it feel?
quests.learnMore:
Fear of failure after going 'all in' is the final boss of the Launch stage.

Your essence knows you're ready. Your body fears what happens if you commit publicly and it doesn't work.

This groan challenges you to make a public, undeniable commitment. Pick a date. Announce it. Burn the boats. When there's no escape route, you'll find resources and resilience you didn't know you had. And even if the launch doesn't go perfectly—you'll learn more from that than from another month of 'preparing.'

quests.name: Responded From Love
quests.description: What's a moment where you were challenged in your work today but reacted from a place of love?
quests.placeholder: What was the situation?
quests.learnMore:
A love response is anything above 'courage' on the emotional frequency scale.

It includes:
Willingness: 'Expressing feelings without blame'.
Acceptance: 'Making decisions from clarity, not emotion'.
Peace: 'Seeing innocence in others, even in conflict'.

This is important because we attract what we are. If we find ourselves responding from anger throughout the day we will attract more anger. If we show up from these higher states we will attract more of them.

Tracking these moments builds awareness and accountability.

quests.name: Responded From Fear
quests.description: What's a moment you were challenged in your work today and reacted from a place of fear?
quests.placeholder: What was the situation? What caused you to be triggered?
quests.learnMore:
A fear response is anything below 'courage' on the emotional frequency scale.

It includes Anger: 'Blaming or pointing out what others did wrong'.
Fear: 'Hesitating or avoiding taking action'.
Shame: 'Going quiet / withdrawing emotionally or physically'.

This is important because we attract more of what we are. If we show up from fear we limit our growth and opportunities that align with what we love.

Tracking these moments builds awareness about what's causing us to react from fear and build accountability to show up from love in the future.

quests.name: Subconscious Task
quests.description: What question or problem will you hand to your subconscious tonight?
quests.placeholder: Give your subconscious a task before bed
quests.learnMore:
Your subconscious mind processes information while you sleep. By giving it a specific question or problem to work on before bed, you tap into a powerful problem-solving engine that works without effort.

This isn't wishful thinking. Research shows that sleep consolidates learning, reorganises memories, and generates creative insights. The key is giving your mind a clear, specific task.

Good examples: 'What would my ideal first offer look like?', 'Why do I keep avoiding that conversation?', 'What am I not seeing about this problem?'

Write it down, read it once, then let go. Trust the process.

quests.name: Trigger Pattern
quests.description: What situations repeatedly triggered you this week? Identify the patterns.
quests.placeholder: What patterns did you notice in your triggers this week?
quests.learnMore:
Our triggers are consistent — the same situations tend to activate us again and again. By tracking weekly patterns, you build a map of your emotional landscape.

Once you can see the pattern, you can prepare for it, heal the root cause, or change the situation entirely.

Common pattern categories: Work deadlines, relationship dynamics, money conversations, self-criticism, social situations, family interactions.

quests.name: Listen To Your Body
quests.description: Tune into how your body responds to a decision you're facing. Your nervous system knows before your mind does.
quests.placeholder: What decision are you sitting with?
quests.learnMore:
Your body holds wisdom your conscious mind often overrides. When facing a decision, your gut tightens, your chest opens, your shoulders drop or rise.

This practice trains you to notice those signals before your protective voice rationalises them away. Over time, you build trust in your body's yes and no.

quests.name: Healing Compass
quests.description: Identify the wound/s causing your Protective Voice to protect you
quests.learnMore:
The Healing Compass is a reflective process that helps you trace your protective patterns back to their origin.

Your protective voice developed as a survival mechanism—understanding the original wound allows you to heal it at the root, rather than just managing symptoms.

This process typically takes 10-15 minutes and will help you gain clarity on why certain patterns keep showing up in your life and what you need to heal to stop them.

quests.name: Map The Boundaries Of Your Nervous System
quests.description: Identify how much money your nervous system feels safe earning before it self-sabotages
quests.learnMore:
Your nervous system has invisible boundaries around money, visibility, and success.

When you approach these edges, your body creates resistance through self-sabotage, procrastination, or fear.

This flow uses sway testing (a muscle-testing practice) to identify exactly where those boundaries are empowering you to consciously expand them.

The flow takes about 10 minutes and since you'll be sway-testing it's recommended you do it at home.

quests.name: Shadow Work Workshop
quests.description: Discover the hidden parts of yourself and trace them to their origin
quests.learnMore:
Shadow work is the process of exploring parts of yourself you've suppressed — both traits you're ashamed of and authentic parts you've hidden to stay safe.

We suppress for two reasons: society told us it was wrong, or we were hurt when we expressed it. Either way, those parts didn't go away — they became shadows.

This flow takes about 15-20 minutes and guides you through identifying your shadows, tracing them to their root emotions, mapping the protective archetypes you use as armour, and discovering the origin story behind it all.

You can complete this once per week to explore different shadows each time.

quests.name: Limiting Belief Rewire
quests.description: Trace a safety contract back to its origin and remove the emotional splinter driving it
quests.learnMore:
In the Nervous System Map, you identified limiting beliefs your body holds around visibility and money.

The Limiting Belief Rewire traces one of those safety contracts back to the original experience that created it — the emotional splinter.

By revisiting the origin with compassion, you can finally release the pattern at its root rather than fighting the symptoms.

This flow takes about 10-15 minutes. Find a quiet, safe space where you can be emotionally present.

quests.name: Identify Your Matrix Codes
quests.description: Discover the invisible beliefs your nervous system built to keep you safe, and the protective pattern running the show
quests.learnMore:
Your nervous system developed invisible rules (matrix codes) to keep you safe. These core beliefs were brilliant survival strategies, but they're now the very things holding you back.

This quiz identifies your top limiting matrix codes and reveals which protective archetype pattern drives your behaviour under pressure.

The quiz takes about 5 minutes.

quests.name: What is Healing?
quests.description: Understand what healing really means and why emotional splinters keep us from being ourselves
quests.learnMore:
Before diving into the healing quests, it helps to understand what healing actually is.

This explainer walks you through the concept of emotional splinters — the micro-traumas that silently shape our behaviour — and reframes healing as removing fear so you can show up as your loving, playful, carefree self once again.

quests.name: What is an Emotional Splinter?
quests.description: Learn about Big T and Little T trauma, how your brain creates protective stories, and what an emotional splinter really is
quests.learnMore:
This deep dive explains how 'emotion' is energy-in-motion and trauma is what happens when that energy gets frozen.

You'll learn about Big T vs Little T trauma, how the amygdala and prefrontal cortex miscommunicate to create limiting stories, and how these unprocessed emotions create protective patterns like The Ghost, The People Pleaser, and The Controller.

quests.name: How Do We Heal?
quests.description: Discover the Four R's framework — Recognise, Release, Rewire, Reconnect — and the healing modalities that map to each
quests.learnMore:
This explainer introduces the Four R's healing framework:

1. Recognise — your emotional splinters and protective patterns
2. Release — the frozen emotions (micro-traumas)
3. Rewire — the beliefs your splinters created
4. Reconnect — to the loving, playful, carefree version of you

You'll also see how every healing modality maps to these four R's.

quests.name: Daily Release Challenge
quests.description: Check the group chat to see the daily release challenge for the day.
quests.placeholder: What came up for you in this process today?

quests.name: Processing Your Emotions
quests.description: When you found yourself feeling negatively charged (anger, fear, guilt, shame) today, rather than bottle it up (a recipe for trauma to develop and future resentment + fear blocks), how did you release it healthily?
quests.placeholder: What emotion were you feeling and how did you release it?
quests.learnMore:
Emotions are energy in motion— see them as a song. When we suppress them, it's like clicking pause in the middle of the song. They get stored in the body and create tension, anxiety and if intense enough, trauma.

Release practices include anything that allow you to experience the emotion and process it so the 'song finishes'. Examples include: running, journaling, breathwork, movement, crying, shaking, screaming (into a pillow), or simply allowing yourself to feel without judgment.

The goal isn't to 'fix' the emotion but to experience it. Doing any of these practises for 90 seconds is often enough for the emotion to pass through you and the 'song to finish'.

quests.name: Big Release
quests.description: Complete an extended release whether it be breathwork or another release practise of your choosing
quests.placeholder: What came up in the session? What did you process and release?
quests.learnMore:
Extended release practices (30+ minutes) allow you to access and clear deeper layers of stored emotion and trauma.

Options include: conscious-connected breathwork, somatic experiencing, rage rituals, ecstatic dance, or guided emotional release sessions.

These practices often bring up unexpected emotions—trust the process and let your body lead.

quests.name: Daily Flow Update
quests.description: Log how things flowed for you today using the Flow Compass
quests.placeholder: What happened? What direction did you flow?
quests.learnMore:
Internal flow = excitement or tired.

Does the thought of the action excite you or tire you?

External flow = Ease or resistance.

When you took action did your intentions came to life as expected and did serendipity's occur? This is Ease.

Or did it not go as expected and did you face unexpected challenges? This is resistance.

North = Action excited you and it flowed with ease. This is a signal for continuing.

East = Action excited you but you faced resistance. This is a signal that a pivot is required.

South = Action felt tiring and you faced resistance. This is a signal that you need to rest and / or stop.

West = Action felt tiring but it led to a new opportunity dropping in. This is a single to potentially explore a new opportunity.

quests.name: Sales Page Copy
quests.description: Write compelling sales copy that converts—headlines, benefits, objections handled, call-to-action
quests.placeholder: Paste your sales page copy or share the link to your live sales page
quests.learnMore:
Your sales copy is the difference between a browser and a buyer.

**Essential elements:**
• **Headline** - Captures attention and speaks to their desired outcome
• **Hook** - 1-2 sentences that make them keep reading
• **Problem** - Clearly articulate the pain they experience
• **Solution** - How your offer solves it uniquely
• **Social Proof** - Testimonials, results, case studies
• **Objections** - Preemptively address their hesitations
• **Call-to-Action** - Clear next step (CTA should be repeated 3+ times)
• **Urgency** - Why they should act now

**Pro tips:**
• Use the exact words from your validation interviews
• Benefits > Features (what it does FOR them, not what it IS)
• Make the CTA button specific ('Start My Transformation' vs 'Submit')
• Break up text with bullets and short paragraphs
quests.archive_reason: Redundant - Landing Page challenge in Campaign stage covers this

quests.name: Product Builder
quests.description: Define your niche, identify why customers are stuck, and brainstorm solutions
quests.learnMore:
Build the foundation of your offer using the $100M Offers framework:

• **Customer Profile** - Pain level, spending capacity, and emotional state
• **Niche Builder** - Combine your Flow Finder discoveries into a sharp niche statement
• **Excuses & Beliefs** - Uncover the vehicle, internal, and external blockers stopping your audience
• **Solutions** - Brainstorm solutions that directly address each problem
• **Core Offer & Lead Magnet** - Define what they pay for and what you give for free

Complete this first, then use Product Designer to apply the Value Equation to each solution.

quests.name: Grand Slam Evaluation
quests.description: Evaluate your product's success potential using the Value Equation
quests.learnMore:
Answer the question: 'If I launched this product, how successful will I be?' This flow evaluates 4 dimensions of the Value Equation:

• **Proof Stack** - Can you prove you deliver? (Perceived Likelihood)
• **Speed Advantage** - How fast do they get results? (Time Delay)
• **Ease Factor** - What do they NOT need to do? (Effort & Sacrifice)
• **Obstacles** - What stops them from buying?

You'll receive a Grand Slam Score (0-100) predicting success potential.

quests.name: Offer Stack Builder
quests.description: Package your offer with Lead Magnet, Bonuses, Guarantee, Scarcity, and Naming
quests.learnMore:
Transform your evaluated product into an irresistible offer stack:

• **Lead Magnet** - Free value that builds trust
• **Bonuses** - Extra value that tips the scales
• **Guarantee** - Risk reversal that removes hesitation
• **Scarcity/Urgency** - Reason to act NOW
• **Naming** - Make it memorable

By the end, you'll have a complete packaged offer ready to present to the world.

quests.name: Product Designer
quests.description: Define your core product's value using the Value Equation framework
quests.learnMore: Apply Hormozi's Value Equation to your core product: Value = (Dream Outcome × Perceived Likelihood) / (Time Delay × Effort). This helps you maximize perceived value.

quests.name: Launch Sequence
quests.description: Plan your 7-day launch sequence: what happens each day from Day -3 to Day +3
quests.placeholder: What's your progress?
quests.learnMore:
A launch isn't one moment—it's a sequence that builds anticipation and urgency.

Simple 7-day launch structure:
• Day -3: Teaser / Coming Soon
• Day -1: Final countdown / Last chance to prepare
• Day 0: LAUNCH - Main announcement
• Day +1: Social proof / First results
• Day +2: FAQ / Objection handling
• Day +3: Urgency / Bonus deadline
• Day +7: Final call / Doors closing

Plan the sequence, then execute daily.

💡 Our CRM includes launch planning tools to help you execute.

quests.name: Nurture Sequence

quests.name: Play-list Self-Trial
quests.description: Apply one of your skills to solve a problem you personally have. Prove it works before helping others.
quests.learnMore:
Before you help someone else, trial your skill on yourself.

**How it works:**
1. Pick a skill from your Flow Finder discoveries
2. Pick a problem you're personally dealing with
3. Plan how you'll apply your skill
4. Do it, then reflect on what happened

**Why it matters:**
This builds confidence that your skills create real value. If it works for you, it'll work for others.

Recommended before your first Peer-Trial, but not required.

quests.name: Play-list Self-Trial Review
quests.description: Reflect on your Self-Trial experience. Complete this after testing a skill on yourself to earn bonus points.
quests.learnMore:
Every self-trial teaches you something about your skills.

**This review helps you:**
• Reflect on what actually happened when you applied your skill
• Rate how the skill worked on your own problem
• Capture surprises and learnings
• Decide if you're ready to help someone else

Complete this after each Self-Trial to earn bonus points and build confidence before your first Peer-Trial.

quests.name: Let's Play Peer-Trial
quests.description: Plan to use one of your skills to solve a real problem for a real person. Then go do it!
quests.learnMore:
The Peer-Trial is bottom-up validation: instead of asking 'would people pay for this?', you actually USE your skill to help someone and see what happens.

**How it works:**
1. Pick a skill × problem combo from your Flow Finder data
2. Choose a real person to help
3. Plan your approach and go do it
4. Come back and reflect on what happened

**Why it matters:**
This proves your skills create real value before you ever build a product. Each trial teaches you something about where you belong.

**Difficulty scales up:**
• Starter: Help someone you know
• Growing (3+): Help someone outside your close circle
• Confident (7+): Help someone you've never met
• Pro (12+): Help someone and ask for a testimonial

quests.name: Let's Play Peer-Trial Review
quests.description: Reflect on your Peer-Trial experience. Complete this after helping someone to earn bonus points.
quests.learnMore:
Every peer-trial teaches you something about your flow.

• Reflect on what actually happened

• Capture surprises and learnings
• Plan what you'd do differently next time

Complete this after each Peer-Trial to earn bonus points and build your validation evidence.

quests.description: Select the bonus you've implemented from your Offer Stack
quests.placeholder: Select a bonus you've created
quests.learnMore:
Great bonuses address specific obstacles your customer faces AFTER buying your core offer.

**Bonus Formula:**
• Identify obstacles to achieving the dream outcome
• Create solutions for each obstacle
• Name them compellingly
• Stack the value (aim for 10x the price in total bonus value)

**Examples:**
• Quick-start guide (reduces time delay)
• Templates/swipe files (reduces effort)
• Community access (increases likelihood of success)
• Bonus training on specific challenge (addresses objection)
quests.archived_reason: Now captured in Offer Stack Builder flow - Jan 2025

quests.name: Implement Your Guarantee
quests.description: Confirm the guarantee you designed in your Offer Stack
quests.placeholder: Select your guarantee type
quests.learnMore:
A guarantee transfers risk from the buyer to you. The stronger the guarantee, the more confident your prospect feels.

**Types of Guarantees:**
• **Unconditional** - "30-day money-back, no questions asked"
• **Conditional** - "If you complete all modules and don't see results, full refund"
• **Performance** - "If you don't get [specific result], I'll work with you until you do"
• **Anti-guarantee** - "All sales final" (works when demand exceeds supply)

Match your guarantee to your offer confidence and customer type.
quests.archived_reason: Now captured in Offer Stack Builder flow - Jan 2025

quests.name: Implement Scarcity & Urgency
quests.description: Confirm the scarcity/urgency element from your Offer Stack
quests.placeholder: Select your scarcity type
quests.learnMore:
Scarcity and urgency give prospects a reason to act NOW rather than "someday."

**Ethical Scarcity Types:**
• **Cohort-based** - Limited spots per cohort (natural capacity limit)
• **Time-based** - Enrollment windows, launch periods
• **Bonus-based** - Bonuses expire after deadline
• **Price-based** - Early-bird pricing, founding member rates
• **Inventory** - Limited supply (physical products)

**Key Rule:** Only use scarcity that's REAL. Fake scarcity destroys trust.

If you can serve unlimited customers, create real constraints (cohort sizes, personal bandwidth, etc.)
